'''"Smooth" Banjaxx Wab and the Scundereds''' was a [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Music/Legends|music]] [[Band/Legends|band]]. They were employed by [[Teemo/Legends|Teemo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] and played in his [[Teemo's palace/Legends|palace's]] throne room. They were known to play "dirty" [[Tatooine blues]] with some [[Wikipedia:virtuoso|virtuoso]] [[Kloo horn/Legends|kloo horn]] flourishes.

The group leader and kloo horn player, [[Banjaxx Wab|"Smooth" Banjaxx Wab]], regularly gave recitals in [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]], where he also played the role of a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for Teemo.
